story: In Stage 10 of the 2026 Tour de France, Lidl-Trek controlled early break attempts up to the intermediate sprint. A large breakaway formed, thinning over time. Tejada and Romo launched attacks, with Romo soloing until 38 km to go. Carapaz and then Pogačar attacked, with Pogačar ultimately catching Carapaz, going solo to victory. Evenepoel finished second, Seixas third.
